sql: SELECT 'fn' AS k, p.proname || ' definer=' || p.prosecdef || ' anon=' || has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') || ' auth=' || has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') AS txt FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname = 'hub_dashboard_metrics' UNION ALL SELECT 'idx', indexname || ' valid=' || i.indisvalid FROM pg_indexes x JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = x.indexname JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid = c.oid WHERE x.indexname IN ('idx_wapi_messages_company_created','idx_campaign_leads_company_created','idx_wapi_conversations_company_created')
